import java.util.*;

    static class MaxFlow {
        int[] l;
        int tot;
        int[] cur;
        int[] d;
        int u, v, s, t, src, sink;
        int[][] E;
        int N;

        MaxFlow(int N) {
            this.N = N;
            l = new int[N];
            tot = 0;
            cur = new int[N];
            d = new int[N];
            E = new int[111111][3];
        }

        void add(int u, int v, int cap) {
            E[tot][0] = v;
            E[tot][1] = l[u];
            E[tot][2] = cap;
            l[u] = tot++;
            E[tot][0] = u;
            E[tot][1] = l[v];
            E[tot][2] = 0;
            l[v] = tot++;
        }

        void init() {
            Arrays.fill(l, -1);
            tot = 0;
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(d, -1);
            System.arraycopy(l, 0, cur, 0, l.length);
            d[src] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();
            Q.add(src);
            while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                u = Q.poll();
                for (int i = l[u]; ~i != 0; i = E[i][1]) {
                    v = E[i][0];
                    if (d[v] == -1 && E[i][2] > 0) {
                        d[v] = d[u] + 1;
                        Q.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return d[sink] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int u, int in) {
            if (u == sink) return in;
            int flow = 0, f;
            for (int i = cur[u]; ~i != 0; i = E[i][1]) {
                v = E[i][0];
                if (d[v] == d[u] + 1 && E[i][2] > 0) {
                    if ((f = dfs(v, Math.min(in - flow, E[i][2]))) > 0) {
                        flow += f;
                        E[i][2] -= f;
                        E[i ^ 1][2] += f;
                        if (flow == in) break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (flow < in) d[u] = -1;
            return flow;
        }

        int dinic(int _src, int _sink) {
            src = _src;
            sink = _sink;
            int flow = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                flow += dfs(src, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static int n;
    static char[][] field = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] capsule = new char[15][15];
    static int[][] Z = new int[15][15];
    static int[][] S = new int[15][15];
    static int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static MaxFlow F;
    static int t;
    static final int inf = 1000000000;

    static boolean In(int i, int j) {
        return i >= 0 && i < n && j >= 0 && j < n;
    }

    static boolean isdigit(char ch) {
        return ch >= '1' && ch <= '9';
    }

    static void bfs(int x, int y, int[][] d, boolean f) {
        int sx = x, sy = y;
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(d[i], inf);
        }
        d[x][y] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        Q.add(x);
        Q.add(y);
        if (f && isdigit(capsule[x][y])) {
            F.add(sx * n + sy, sx * n + sy + n * n, inf);
        }
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            x = Q.poll();
            y = Q.poll();
            if (d[x][y] == t) break;
            for (int o = 0; o < 4; o++) {
                int xx = x + dx[o];
                int yy = y + dy[o];
                if (In(xx, yy) && d[xx][yy] == inf && capsule[xx][yy] != 'Y') {
                    if (Z[xx][yy] > d[x][y] + 1 || (Z[xx][yy] == d[x][y] + 1 && isdigit(capsule[xx][yy]))) {
                        d[xx][yy] = d[x][y] + 1;
                        if (f && isdigit(capsule[xx][yy])) {
                            F.add(sx * n + sy, xx * n + yy + n * n, inf);
                        }
                        if (Z[xx][yy] > d[x][y] + 1 || !f) {
                            Q.add(xx);
                            Q.add(yy);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        int src = n * n * 2;
        int sink = src + 1;
        F = new MaxFlow(210);
        F.init();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            field[i] = line.toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (field[i][j] == 'Z') {

        int x = -1, y = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

                if (field[i][j] == 'Z') {

                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            capsule[i] = line.toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (isdigit(capsule[i][j])) {
                    F.add(i * n + j + n * n, sink, capsule[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        bfs(x, y, Z, false);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

                if (isdigit(field[i][j])) {
